name: Chromium Rhuell
description: An elder dragon who takes human form to observe humans and recommends destroying the human chief; he flies off after rebuking Nicol.

timeline.summary: In the vision, a blind great shadow beats its wings and drops egg-stones from which dragons wake, as Arcades Sabboth, Chromium Rhuell and Palladia-Mors name themselves.
timeline.quote: By naming itself it takes control of its own destiny.

timeline.summary: Two large egg-stones crack into the ground without waking, and Palladia-Mors dismisses them as weak and goes hunting.
timeline.quote: These two were too weak to wake up. Good riddance.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
timeline.quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
timeline.quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
timeline.quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

relations.note: Rhuell rebukes Nicol for twisting his words
relations.quote: I hear what you are doing, Nicol Bolas.

pages_say.description: A metallic dragon, curious, who lands on the mountain peak and flies off to seek cousins.
A metallic-scaled elder dragon, a scholar of creatures who lives by a lake and sends the twins away.
An elder dragon who takes human form to observe humans and recommends destroying the human chief; he flies off after rebuking Nicol.
A clever dragon who hides himself pretending to be something else.
A surviving elder dragon who wanders in the guise of a helpful observer.
A dragon whose example Ugin recalls.
